title: Bhogapuram Airport: Air India Express to fly Visakhapatnam-Bangkok twice a week from October 27
description: Flight IX 904 leaves Visakhapatnam at 11.30 a.m. on Tuesdays and Fridays and the return lands at 3.55 a.m. on Wednesdays and Saturdays; the Andhra Pradesh Air Travellers Association has pressed for the service for years
